title: Alcohol consumption caveat
intro: Weekly drinking ranges describe consumption, not a liver diagnosis or a guarantee of safety.

ranges.label: Below the weekly heavy-drinking threshold
ranges.note: For whole drinks, this is 0–7 and 0–14 respectively. Below the threshold does not mean risk-free.

ranges.label: Heavy drinking
ranges.note: This level of consumption increases health risks, including liver disease.

ranges.label: More than 20 drinks per week
ranges.note: Exceeds both weekly heavy-drinking thresholds; it does not define a separate diagnosis or severity stage.

standard_drink: These are U.S. standard drinks: 14 g of pure alcohol each. A large serving or strong beverage may contain more than one standard drink.
caveat: Weekly totals do not capture binge drinking. A low questionnaire risk estimate does not cancel alcohol-related risk. This model's alcohol association must not be interpreted as a protective effect of drinking.
